pushup.name: Push-up
steps: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest until it is a fist-width from the floor, elbows about 45° from your body.
Push the floor away to return to the top. Keep your stomach tight the whole time.
pushup.tip: Too hard? Put your hands on a bed or table, or drop to your knees.

inclinepush.name: Incline push-up
steps: Put your hands on a sturdy table, bed edge or wall.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge, then press back up.
inclinepush.tip: The lower the surface, the harder it gets.

dbbench.name: Dumbbell bench press
steps: Lie on a bench or the floor with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Lower the weights slowly to the sides of your chest.
Press up until your arms are straight, without banging the dumbbells together.
dbbench.tip: On the floor, pause when your elbows touch down.

bench.name: Barbell bench press
steps: Lie with eyes under the bar, feet flat, shoulder blades squeezed together.
Unrack and lower the bar to mid-chest with control.
Press up and slightly back until your arms lock out.
bench.tip: Always use a spotter or safety pins when going heavy.

machinepress.name: Machine chest press
steps: Set the seat so handles are at mid-chest height.
Press forward until arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.
machinepress.tip: A good first chest exercise for beginners in a gym.

pike.name: Pike push-up
steps: Start in a push-up, then walk your feet in so your hips point up like an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up to the V position.
pike.tip: Feet on a step makes it harder.

dbpress.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
steps: Sit or stand tall with dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to shoulder height with control.
dbpress.tip: Do not arch your lower back. Squeeze your glutes.

lateral.name: Lateral raise
steps: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly over 2–3 seconds.
lateral.tip: Use a light weight. No swinging.

dips.name: Chair dips
steps: Sit on the edge of a stable chair, hands next to your hips.
Slide your hips off the chair and bend your elbows to about 90°.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
dips.tip: Bend your knees to make it easier.

ohext.name: Overhead triceps extension
steps: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift it back up. Keep elbows pointing forward.
ohext.tip: Keep your ribs down; do not lean back.

pushdown.name: Cable triceps pushdown
steps: Hold the rope or bar at chest height, elbows tucked at your sides.
Push down until your arms are straight.
Let it rise back to chest height slowly.

tablerow.name: Table row
steps: Lie under a sturdy table and grab its edge with both hands.
Keeping your body straight, pull your chest up toward the table.
Lower yourself slowly.
tablerow.tip: Bend your knees to make it easier. Test the table first.

superman.name: Superman hold
steps: Lie face down with arms stretched forward.
Lift arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold, breathing normally.
superman.tip: Look at the floor to keep your neck relaxed.

dbrow.name: One-arm dumbbell row
steps: Put one hand and knee on a bench or chair, the other foot on the floor.
Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip.
Lower it until your arm is straight. Do all reps, then switch sides.
dbrow.tip: Think about pulling with your elbow, not your hand.

bentrow.name: Bent-over dumbbell row
steps: Hold dumbbells, hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Pull both weights to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.
bentrow.tip: Keep your back flat, not rounded.

pulldown.name: Lat pulldown
steps: Sit with thighs under the pad, hands a little wider than shoulders.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, leaning back slightly.
Let it rise until your arms are straight.
pulldown.tip: Do not pull the bar behind your neck.

cablerow.name: Seated cable row
steps: Sit tall with feet on the platform and a slight knee bend.
Pull the handle to your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
cablerow.tip: Keep your chest up; do not rock.

facepull.name: Face pull
steps: Set a rope at face height.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows high, hands ending beside your ears.
Return slowly.
facepull.tip: Great for posture if you sit all day.

revfly.name: Reverse fly
steps: Hinge forward with light dumbbells hanging below your chest.
Raise your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

curl.name: Dumbbell biceps curl
steps: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders, elbows fixed at your sides.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

towelcurl.name: Towel curl
steps: Sit on a chair and loop a towel under one foot, holding both ends.
Curl your hands up while pushing down gently with your foot for resistance.
Lower slowly, keeping the tension on.
towelcurl.tip: Your foot controls how hard it is.

sqbw.name: Bodyweight squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees as if sitting on a chair.
Go as low as is comfortable, then stand up by pushing through your whole foot.
sqbw.tip: Knees follow your toes. Squat to a chair if you need to.

goblet.name: Goblet squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell vertically at your chest.
Squat down between your knees, keeping your chest up.
Stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.
goblet.tip: Elbows brush the inside of your knees at the bottom.

backsquat.name: Barbell back squat
steps: Bar rests on your upper back, feet shoulder-width.
Take a big breath, brace your stomach and squat until thighs are about parallel.
Drive up, keeping your chest up.
backsquat.tip: Use the squat rack safety bars.

legpress.name: Leg press
steps: Sit with feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safeties and lower until knees are near 90°.
Press back up without locking your knees.
legpress.tip: Keep your lower back on the pad.

lunge.name: Reverse lunge
steps: Stand tall, then step one foot back.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90°.
Push through your front foot to come back. Alternate legs.
lunge.tip: Hold a wall for balance at first.

dblunge.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Step back and lower until both knees are about 90°.
Drive through your front heel to stand. Alternate legs.

rdl.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
steps: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the weights down your legs, back flat.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then stand up by pushing your hips forward.
rdl.tip: Your back must stay flat. Range ends where flatness ends.

glutebridge.name: Glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat near your hips.
Push through your heels and lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes for one second, then lower.
glutebridge.tip: Place a dumbbell on your hips to make it harder.

stepup.name: Step-up
steps: Stand facing a sturdy step or low bench.
Step up with one foot and stand fully on it.
Step down with control. Do all reps, then switch legs.
stepup.tip: Push through the top foot, not the bottom one.

calf.name: Standing calf raise
steps: Stand on the edge of a step, heels hanging off.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels below the step slowly.

wallsit.name: Wall sit
steps: Lean your back against a wall.
Slide down until your knees are bent (aim for 90°).
Hold, breathing steadily.
wallsit.tip: Go only as low as is pain-free.

plank.name: Plank
steps: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders.
Lift your body so it is straight from head to heels.
Hold, squeezing your stomach and glutes.
plank.tip: Do not let your hips sag or pike up.

deadbug.name: Dead bug
steps: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent at 90° above your hips.
Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides. Keep your lower back pressed down.

bicycle.name: Bicycle crunch
steps: Lie on your back, hands lightly behind your head.
Bring one knee in while rotating the opposite elbow toward it.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.
bicycle.tip: Do not pull on your neck.

mountain.name: Mountain climbers
steps: Start in a high plank.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
mountain.tip: Slow it down if your form slips.

highknees.name: High knees
steps: Stand tall and run on the spot.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Pump your arms and stay light on your feet.

march.name: Fast march on the spot
steps: Stand tall and march on the spot.
Lift your knees high and swing your arms.
Keep a pace where talking is hard but possible.
